description: React component for rendering the header of a chat channel, including status, icons, and actions.

classes.name: ChannelHeader
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing the channel header UI.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches custom emojis and remote channel names when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates emojis and remote names when channel props change.

methods.name: unmute
methods.description: Unmutes the current channel for the user.

methods.name: showPinnedPosts
methods.description: Toggles display of pinned posts in the right-hand side panel.

methods.name: showChannelFiles
methods.description: Displays the channel files in the right-hand side panel.

methods.name: toggleChannelMembersRHS
methods.description: Toggles display of channel members in the right-hand side panel.

methods.name: renderCustomStatus
methods.description: Renders the custom status emoji and text if set.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire channel header UI including icons, status, and actions.
